page.layout: One page of text on the right printed page, one column, running head at top centre, page number at top right, catchword and signature at foot. No marginal notes. The left strip of the scan is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Et Bodinus quidem, præfat. in suam Dæmonomaniam, scribit Hebræos omnes Philosophos & Academicos ostendisse, Aristotelem nihil vidisse, ἐν τοῖς νοητοῖς: & naturalium pulcherrimas res non paucas ignorasse; imo ne millesimam quidem partem rerum naturalium tenuisse.
Errores, quos in specie attingunt, heic recitare longum nimis foret. Hoc enim in contemplationibus nostris fiet opportunius.

Cardinales Cusanus & Bessarion, cum multa viderent naturæ adhuc esse miracula, quorum obscurae & ignotæ essent causæ, eò sunt adducti, ut Aristotelicam doctrinam tanquam variam, ambiguam & incertam perstringerent.

Cardinalis Alliacensis certis defendit & confirmavit rationibus, nullam in toto Aristotele extare demonstrationem necessariam, præter eam, qua demonstravit unicum esse Deum, & alias perpaucas, quas annotat.
Plutarchus, Galenus, Stoici & Academici, imò & Epicu-rei Aristotelis, de mundi æternitate, demonstratione, tanquam plenam ignorantiæ exagitarunt.

Veteres, post signum Aristotelis, finxere mulierem Velatam facie, cui nomen esset Physis, hoc est: Natura: qua indigitarunt, naturæ dignitatem fuisse tectam Aristoteli, & vestem solum externam quodammodo ab eo fuisse visam.

De Patricius [?] quid dicam: Extant spissa ipsorum volumina quibus in plerisque, Aristotelem à vero aberrasse, & si quæ vera habet, ex veteribus descripsisse, suppressis [?] eorum nominibus & libris, demonstrant: Viri certe undiquaque doctissi-
main_text.notes: Page number "35" is printed at the top right and is hard to read; it may be "33". Running head read as printed. "Patricius" in the line "De Patricius quid dicam" is doubtful. "suppressis" is doubtful: the long s forms are hard to read at this scan resolution. The Greek "ἐν τοῖς νοητοῖς" is copied as far as the scan allows; accents may be imprecise. Signature "C" and catchword "mi," are at the foot. The paragraph ends on the hyphenated word "doctissi-" as printed.
